title: USDA FoodData Central Branded Foods
attribution: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service. FoodData Central. Branded Foods, April 2026 release. https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/
source_verification: Official download page lists Branded 04/2026 in CSV and JSON. Local filenames carry 2026-04-30. Local checksums measure integrity, not upstream authenticity.
unknown_fields_note: Original browser download URL and timestamp were not recorded; do not infer them from file mtime or ingestion date.

quality_gate_scope: File exists/nonzero/.csv, exact header, CSV shape and declared numeric types on first 1000 parsed records or all records if fewer. SHA-256 covers the entire file. This is not full-data semantic validation.
json_status: Archive inventoried; no JSON extraction or ingestion at Checkpoint 2

scope: Environment, ingestion, raw storage and provenance. Beverage filtering, table joins, nutrient normalization and dashboards deferred.
